question: Who was the first woman to be elected as the President of Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant was the first woman to be elected as the President of the Indian National Congress.**
 
• She was elected President of the Indian National Congress at the Calcutta session in 1917.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She was a social reformer, theosophist, and Indian independence leader.
 
• Annie Besant was born in Britain and arrived in India in 1893.
 
• Annie Besant was the second President of The Theosophical Society from 1907 to 1933.
 
• She started the Young Men’s Indian Association in 1914.
 
• Annie Besant launched the Home Rule League in September 1916 at Madras.
 
• She also started two journals: 
 
 
• The Commonweal, a weekly dealing with issues of national reform and New India, a daily newspaper which for fifteen years was a powerful instrument promoting Home Rule and revolutionizing Indian journalism.
 
 
 
• **Sucheta Kripalani** was not only the first woman Chief Minister (CM) of Uttar Pradesh (UP) but also the first woman CM of India.
 
• Indian Prime Minister** Indira Gandhi** was the first and only female Prime Minister of India.
 
 
• She was the second longest-serving Indian prime minister after her father Jawahar Lal Nehru.
 
• She was also the President of INC in 1959.
